supplies.analysis: The school furniture programme must be divided into lots below the EU threshold of €221,000. Four lots are proposed, each with a competitive procedure and a sustainability criterion. The lots are: lot 1 (desks and chairs), lot 2 (classroom equipment), lot 3 (library furniture), and lot 4 (administrative furniture). orchestration_result.final_recommendation: The school furniture programme cannot be put into one single lot as it exceeds the EU threshold of €221,000. Instead, the programme will be divided into four lots: lot 1 (desks and chairs) with an estimated value of €200,000, lot 2 (classroom equipment) with an estimated value of €180,000, lot 3 (library furniture) with an estimated value of €220,000, and lot 4 (administrative furniture) with an estimated value of €200,000.
